_help: Settings for one wheel. The folder name is the wheel's id; list it in wheels/index.json.
All sizes in mm. The back plate DXF should be drawn in mm with the wheel centre at 0,0 (or set origin).
name: shown in the wheel list.
dxf: the back plate drawing in this folder. The largest closed shape becomes the outline; circles become holes; other closed shapes inside become no-go areas.
outline / extraHoles: use instead of (or next to) a DXF. outline = [[x,y], ...]; extraHoles = [{"x":0,"y":0,"d":3.3,"role":"mount"|"noGo"}].
origin (optional): [x, y] of the wheel centre in the DXF, if it isn't at 0,0.
edgeMargin: how far parts must stay from the outline (the wheel's border).
holes.mount: circle diameters that are front plate screw holes. They are cut through the front plate; clearance = free space around them.
holes.noGo: circle diameters that are no-go areas (handle bolts, hub). Not cut; parts keep clearance away from them.
holes.otherCircles: what to do with circles matching neither list: noGo, mount or ignore. holes.otherShapes: same for other closed shapes (noGo or ignore).
plateSpacing / frontPlateThickness: defaults applied when this wheel is picked.
chamfer: 45° chamfer on the top edge of the front plate, in mm. outline = the outer edge, mountHoles = the mounting holes. 0 or left out = no chamfer.
layers (optional): only read these DXF layers.

handles: F1-style grips behind the back plate. left.holes = the mount holes on the left side, left.path = the grip centre line (plate coordinates, from one mount hole to another); mirror copies them to the right. grip = oval cross-section width x depth; the grip's top always sits gapBelowFrontPlate mm below the underside of the front plate. Bolts go through the mount holes the grip covers: bolt = hole and head diameters, seat = material left under the bolt head. Each handle is split at mid-depth into two halves.
example: the layout loaded by 'Load example' for this wheel.
